treatments.title: Smile Design
treatments.description: A considered approach to a brighter, naturally beautiful smile.
treatments.detail: Explore teeth whitening, veneers and gum contouring with a plan shaped around your features and your goals. We assess your oral health first and discuss suitable options before treatment.

treatments.title: Dental Implants
treatments.description: Restore your smile. Rediscover everyday confidence.
treatments.detail: Dental implants can replace one or more missing teeth. Our team offers single and multiple implants, implant-supported dentures and full-arch options. A consultation helps determine your suitability and treatment plan.

treatments.title: Root Canal Care
treatments.description: Precision-led treatment to preserve your natural teeth.
treatments.detail: Led by Dr. Harpreet Singh, our endodontic care includes root canal treatment, re-treatment and microscopic root canal procedures. We focus on treating the source of discomfort and preserving your natural tooth wherever possible.

treatments.title: Braces & Aligners
treatments.description: Thoughtfully aligned teeth, for a smile that feels like you.
treatments.detail: Choose from metal, ceramic and lingual braces, or explore clear aligners. We assess your bite, explain the options and help you understand the expected timeline and ongoing care.

treatments.title: Family Dentistry
treatments.description: Gentle, attentive care for every member of your family.
treatments.detail: From children’s dental visits to routine examinations, fillings and preventive care, we help the whole family build healthy habits and maintain their smiles.

treatments.title: Gum & Oral Care
treatments.description: Healthy foundations for a smile that lasts.
treatments.detail: Professional cleaning, scaling and gum disease treatment help protect your oral health. We also provide wisdom tooth assessment and oral surgery consultations when needed.
